source: This note is for aquarium visitors whose booked tide-pool session is cancelled. They can collect a free indoor fish-trail card at reception and should check the same-day cancellation notice before travel. The trail uses public step-free corridors. At two trial openings 26 cards were handed out. Staff did not record completion or satisfaction. The note helps affected visitors adapt their visit; it is not a staff evaluation.

idea.title: An indoor fish trail after a tide-pool cancellation
idea.description: Tell affected visitors where to collect the free trail card and to check the same-day notice before travel.
idea.audience: Visitors whose booked tide-pool session is cancelled
idea.rationale: The step-free indoor route may offer affected visitors a practical alternative during cancellation.
idea.evidence: Free reception card; same-day notice; public step-free corridors.
